app.title: Sektor 7
loading.tips: Hold the right mouse button to turn the camera. Use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
Holding the left and right mouse buttons together makes your character run straight ahead.
You walk by default. Hold Shift to run.
Left-clicking an enemy selects it as your target and starts the automatic attack. Press Escape to clear your selection.
Power Strike on key 1 deals double damage but costs energy and has a cooldown. It only works with melee weapons.
Ranged weapons use up ammunition with every shot and need a clear line of sight to the target. You can find ammunition as loot or buy it from the trader.
Press B to open your backpack and C for the character window. Equip gear by clicking it in your backpack.
Move the mouse over an item to see its stats. In the backpack you can destroy items through the menu.
Outside of combat, health and energy regenerate on their own after a short while.
When your character dies, it loses all experience of the current level. Levels you have already reached are never lost.
Loot belongs to the player who defeated the enemy. The coin pouch disappears after two minutes, so grab your items in time.
Chests are hidden in the world. Each character can open each chest only once. After that it is gone for them for good.
An icon above the head of a trader or drifter shows that there is something to do. Left-click them to talk.
Use /g to write in global chat. Without a prefix, only players nearby can hear you.
Enemies with a higher level than you are more dangerous, but they also drop better loot.
Enemies only chase you a certain distance from their spawn point. If you escape them, they return and heal.
You can recognise doors and other entrances by the mouse cursor turning into a hand when you hover over them. You have to be close enough.
Press Esc to open the menu in the portal (where you can also change the language) and M for the map. Click the map to place markers, which also show on the minimap.
Sell items you do not need to the trader. Scrap metal and rags earn you a little money.
Press F11 to go fullscreen. Browser shortcuts like Ctrl+W are locked there, so you can crouch-walk without closing the tab.

zone.startwelt.name: Wasteland – Sector 7
zone.plattenbau_innen.name: Apartment Block (Interior)
npc.streuner.name: Drifter
npc.streuner.greeting: Keep your head down, stranger. Not everyone survives the night out in the wasteland.
npc.haendler.name: Scrap Trader
npc.haendler.greeting: Metal, cloth, canned goods – I take anything that is still worth something.
npc.pumpenwart.name: Pump Keeper
npc.pumpenwart.greeting: As long as the tower holds water, the settlement holds. I make sure it stays that way. And pray that nothing breaks.
npc.funkerin.name: Radio Operator
npc.funkerin.greeting: Shh. Hear that static? Voices hide in between. You just have to know when to listen and when not to.
npc.kanalwaerter.name: Sewer Warden
npc.kanalwaerter.greeting: See that manhole cover over there? The gates are guarded, the fences high, but underground runs a path that is on no map. Anyone who really wants out of Sector 7 does not go through the gate. Bring a light, a weapon and strong nerves. The rats are the least of your problems.
npc.gildenverwalter.name: Guild Steward
npc.gildenverwalter.greeting: Alone you last a few weeks. Anyone who wants backing founds a guild or joins one.

ability.power_strike.name: Power Strike
ability.power_strike.description: A mighty blow with full force.
quest.clear_raiders.name: Drive Off the Raiders
quest.clear_raiders.offer: Raiders are lurking east of the car wreck and attack anyone who comes near. Clear a few of them out of the way, then we will talk.
quest.clear_raiders.progress: Not enough yet? The raiders are loitering east of the car wreck.
quest.clear_raiders.complete: Well done. That gives us some breathing room. Here, take this. And stick with the scrap trader, he pays for anything that shines.
quest.scrap_for_trader.name: Materials for the Trader
quest.scrap_for_trader.offer: The scrap trader is putting together something useful and needs materials. Bring him scrap metal and rags. You will find both on the raiders.
quest.scrap_for_trader.progress: The trader is waiting for scrap metal and rags.
quest.scrap_for_trader.complete: Exactly what I needed. Here, I put this together for you.
quest.stray_name.name: A Name on the List
quest.stray_name.offer: I keep a tally of those who did not come back. Marta has been on it for four days. She was headed for the warehouse in the southwest, the one with the broken-open roller door. Go and look. And do not bring back anything I do not want to see.
quest.stray_name.progress: The warehouse in the southwest. The roller door stands open, you cannot miss it.
quest.stray_name.complete: Just a ring? Was that all there was? ... Then that is how it is. Take this, for the road. And leave me alone for a moment.
quest.stray_name.objective.0: Visit the warehouse in the southwest
quest.trader_goods.name: Goods Without Papers
quest.trader_goods.offer: I need canned food and dog fur. The fur goes into coats, the cans onto tables, and where both come from is nobody's concern. Not even mine. Just bring it.
quest.trader_goods.progress: Five cans, four pelts. I do not count how you get them.
quest.trader_goods.complete: Clean. Questions cost extra with me, which is why I do not ask any. Here, the jacket was still lying around.
quest.trader_debt.name: Debts Do Not Expire
quest.trader_debt.offer: A few marauders in the southwest have owed me ammunition since spring. I do not send reminders. They do not have to pay it back alive.
quest.trader_debt.progress: The marauders roam the southwest. They are sturdy fellows, do not go unprepared.
quest.trader_debt.complete: Then we are even. With them, I mean. With you anyway. This is your severance.
quest.pump_parts.name: Running Dry
quest.pump_parts.offer: The pump is sucking air. Seal gone, linkage bent. I need scrap metal and duct tape, nothing more. Without water we do not need to worry about anything else.
quest.pump_parts.progress: Scrap and duct tape. I will straighten the linkage myself once you bring me the material.
quest.pump_parts.complete: That will hold. For now. Here, something for your trouble. Drink something before you head out again.
quest.pump_valve.name: The Missing Valve
quest.pump_valve.offer: Someone removed the shut-off valve. That is what someone does who is looking for trade goods. I saw him vanish to the south with the thing under the tarp of a wreck. It was a wreck with a green tarp, south of the power line, not far from the raiders' tent. Take a look at the spot and let me know if it is still there.
quest.pump_valve.progress: The wreck with the green tarp. South of the power line, near the raiders' tent.
quest.pump_valve.complete: So that is where it was. How brazen. I will fetch it myself later when the coast is clear. Here, you earned this.
quest.pump_valve.objective.0: Inspect the wreck with the green tarp
quest.pump_dogs.name: Pack at the Well
quest.pump_dogs.offer: For a few nights now a pack has been prowling around the water tower. They smell the moisture and grow bolder. I do not want someone lying at the well tomorrow with a mauled calf. Take care of them.
quest.pump_dogs.progress: Stray and feral dogs. They lurk at the edge of the settlement.
quest.pump_dogs.complete: Finally some peace. That was not pretty, but necessary. Take this, I still had it from better times.
quest.radio_power.name: Power for the Voice
quest.radio_power.offer: My radio runs on batteries, and they are all gone. One single fresh one, plus duct tape for the contacts and some scrap for the casing. Good equipment is worth more than good friends. The equipment does not betray you.
quest.radio_power.progress: One battery, two rolls of duct tape, three pieces of scrap. Then I can carry on.
quest.radio_power.complete: Listen to that. Static. Wonderful, honest static. Here, for your trouble.
quest.radio_mast.name: The Second Mast
quest.radio_mast.offer: My reception is bad. I suspect the antenna line is chafed through. It hangs on the power line in the south, at the second mast counting from the west. See if something hangs or lies there that does not belong, and report back.
quest.radio_mast.progress: The power line in the south. The second mast counting from the west.
quest.radio_mast.complete: Chafed through, as I thought. Someone cut the cable, on purpose. Interesting. And unpleasant.
quest.radio_mast.objective.0: Inspect the second mast of the power line
quest.radio_containers.name: Between the Containers
quest.radio_containers.offer: I need a new antenna cable. In the container yard in the northeast there is some, in the alley between the green and the ochre container. Raiders hang around there, tidy up a bit, then take a look at the spot.
quest.radio_containers.progress: Northeast, the container yard. Between the green and the ochre container.
quest.radio_containers.complete: The cable is off. I only have to find it. Good work. I have this left over.
quest.radio_containers.objective.1: Visit the alley between the green and ochre container

intro.title: Welcome to Sector Seven
abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.hint: Drag abilities onto the action bar. Dragging one off the bar removes it.
class.soldier.name: Ex-Soldier
class.soldier.description: Years of service taught you to stay calm when things get loud. You hit harder with firearms, and your old training has your back when it counts.
class.butcher.name: Butcher
class.butcher.description: You spent your life working with knife and cleaver. When it comes to close combat you know exactly where to strike, and you are tougher than you look.
class.builder.name: Construction Worker
class.builder.description: Steel-toed boots, hard hat, twelve-hour shifts. You take more punishment than most and do not go down easily.
class.medic.name: Paramedic
class.medic.description: You learned to treat wounds under pressure. Bandages and medicine work much better in your hands than in anyone else's.
class.medic.bonus: +40% healing from Bandage up, bandages and medicine
class.scout.name: Scout
class.scout.description: You know the back routes and find what others overlook. You move faster, get noticed later and pick up more gold.
class.scout.bonus: +10% movement speed, −20% enemy aggro range, +25% gold from loot

npc.greta.name: Greta
npc.greta.greeting: If you have time, if you could look for someone who did not come back ... Sorry. I do not know who else to ask.
npc.kolja.name: Kolja
npc.kolja.greeting: What do you want? I am busy.
npc.hubert.name: Hubert
npc.hubert.greeting: If this is about the garden bed: it is mine. Anything else is none of your business.

connection.lost.closed: The connection to the server was interrupted. Confirm to reload the page.

speech.wirr.1: Has anyone seen my left shoe? No, the right one. Actually ... the left one too.
speech.wirr.2: Today is Tuesday. I think. Or Thursday.
speech.wirr.3: If you stare at a tin can long enough, it starts staring back.
speech.wirr.4: I swear the pigeons around here made a pact yesterday.
speech.wirr.5: Two soups, one without soup, please. ... Oh, I'm talking to myself again.
speech.wirr.6: My knee says rain. My knee is never wrong. Except always.
speech.wirr.7: There's a key lying around here somewhere. To something.
speech.wirr.8: You get used to everything. Except the smell of cabbage soup.
speech.wirr.9: Nine, ten, eleven ... I've lost count again.
speech.wirr.10: I used to know a fish that could whistle. Well. Almost.
speech.wirr.11: Yesterday's bread is today's bread. Just with more character.
speech.wirr.12: Psst. Can you hear that? No? Good. Neither can I.
speech.wirr.13: Cold today. Or maybe I'm warm. Hard to tell.
speech.wirr.14: Look down and you'll find screws. Look up and you'll trip over them.
speech.lore.1: The loudspeakers keep saying it over and over: The situation is under control. Don't ask me whose.
speech.lore.2: Please remain at your assigned location ... I forgot mine, honestly.
speech.lore.3: They say that on the day of the Standstill every clock stopped at the same moment. Mine runs slow, that's enough for me.
speech.lore.4: The pump supposedly still takes orders. Even though the line is cut. Ask whoever maintained it.
speech.lore.5: There's supposed to be a record of an evacuation in the archive that officially never happened. Whoever says that must have a key.
speech.lore.6: One building still says: Access only with permission of the Central Administration. It supposedly doesn't exist anymore. So who do you ask?
speech.lore.7: Two slips of paper, two dates, one event. Somebody made a mistake. Or several somebodies.
speech.lore.8: Some facilities run like clockwork, and right next to them everything rusts. Who maintains the one and not the other?
speech.lore.9: They say documents were altered before the Standstill. I wasn't there. But I know someone who knows someone.
speech.lore.10: The sector program was meant to carry us through any crisis. Well, we made it through. More or less.
speech.lore.11: Order, self-determination, knowledge. Everyone has their truth, nobody has the whole picture.
speech.lore.12: The supply system still lists people nobody knows. They're being supplied, at least.
speech.lore.13: All my former colleagues remember their orders differently. Either their memory was bad or the orders were.
speech.lore.14: Whoever repairs radios sometimes hears more than they'd like. Mostly static.
speech.flugzeug.1: There! The airplane again. Same loop over Sector 7 every day.
speech.flugzeug.2: Who's sitting up there? And what is it even flying on?
speech.flugzeug.3: It doesn't answer the radio. The radio operator tried. It just keeps flying.
speech.flugzeug.4: Maybe it's looking for something. Or someone. Maybe even us.
speech.flugzeug.5: Maybe it only flies because nobody ever switched it off. That would almost be worse.
speech.flugzeug.6: An airplane that never lands. That can't be a coincidence. Or can it? I don't know.
speech.flugzeug.7: I count the laps. Three yesterday. Let's see what today brings.
speech.flugzeug.8: Do you hear that? That humming up high? Don't tell me it's a coincidence.
speech.flugzeug.9: If it belongs to us, why doesn't it land? And if it doesn't, who does it belong to?
speech.flugzeug.10: Some say it belongs to the sector program. Others say it's a sign. I say: it's an airplane. But why?
speech.flugzeug.11: It never comes closer and never flies away. Something keeps it here.
speech.flugzeug.12: If you look up long enough, you start to imagine it waves back.
quest.mord_1.name: A Brother Does Not Come Home
quest.mord_1.offer: My brother Jonas has been gone for four days. He only wanted to pop over to the old nursery at the western edge of the forest to look for spare parts for the water filter, and be back before dark. Nobody here asks questions, everyone has enough troubles of their own. You ask around for me. The innkeeper knows everyone who comes through his door in the evening, and the general trader knows who buys what.
quest.mord_1.progress: The innkeeper and the general trader. I will not ask for more, for now.
quest.mord_1.complete: Rope and a flashlight, and an argument in front of the stall. And Kolja followed him. Thank you. That is more than I found out in four days.
quest.mord_1.objective.0.text: Jonas? Yes, he sat with me until evening four days ago. Drank nothing, kept glancing at the door. He said he still had to go to the nursery in the west. Shortly after him Kolja left, the scrap trader's assistant, without having ordered anything. That is all I know.
quest.mord_1.objective.1.text: Jonas bought a rope and a flashlight from me and asked if I had batteries. He did not seem scared, more determined. In front of my stall he argued with Hubert, I did not catch what about. Then he walked off to the west.
quest.mord_2.name: Blood in the Grass
quest.mord_2.offer: The innkeeper saw him head toward the nursery. I cannot manage to go there myself. Look along the western forest edge, on the path in front of the old nursery. If there is something there, I want to know what. And watch out for the dogs roaming around there.
quest.mord_2.progress: The western forest edge, in front of the old nursery. Beware of the dogs.
quest.mord_2.complete: A drag mark. Then he did not enter the forest of his own free will. ... No, say nothing. If you can go on, follow it. I can no longer cope with waiting.
quest.mord_2.objective.0: Examine the forest path in front of the nursery
quest.mord_2.objective.0.text: The grass on the forest path is trampled flat. Dark stains, long dried, and two deep furrows, as if something heavy was dragged between the trees. The trail leads deeper into the forest.
quest.mord_3.name: What the Forest Hides
quest.mord_3.offer: Follow the drag mark. I know what you might find there. Still I am asking you. I would rather know than picture something every night.
quest.mord_3.progress: The drag mark leads deeper into the forest. Follow it.
quest.mord_3.complete: His jacket. Of course. And the notebook ... that is his handwriting. Thank you for telling me, and for not making it prettier than it was. Two names are in it. I will not let go of them.
quest.mord_3.objective.0: Examine the site in the forest
quest.mord_3.objective.0.text: Between the roots lies a man, half under leaves. The jacket matches Greta's description. The back of the head is smashed in, not by an animal. The pockets are turned inside out. He has been lying here for days.
quest.mord_3.objective.1: Examine the notebook in the leaves
quest.mord_3.objective.1.text: A little way off lies a torn-open notebook in the leaves, soaked and half rotted. Almost everything is illegible. Two lines can still be made out: “K. still owes me 40, ask Monday.” And further down: “H. was at my bed again. This has to stop.”
quest.mord_4.name: Questions Nobody Wants to Hear
quest.mord_4.offer: K. and H. Kolja, whom Jonas lent money. And Hubert, with whom he has been quarreling over the beds since spring. Ask them both. And ask the apothecary, Jonas was with him shortly before he disappeared. I want to know who is lying.
quest.mord_4.progress: Kolja, Hubert and the apothecary. Listen closely to what they do not say.
quest.mord_4.complete: Both have an excuse, and both sound tired saying it. I cannot tell them apart. But Jonas hurt himself on a fence shortly before? Then we will look at both hiding places.
quest.mord_4.objective.0.text: I was at the scrapyard that evening, ask anyone. Yes, Jonas lent me forty gold. So what? Nobody kills for forty gold. Leave me alone. I have enough to do.
quest.mord_4.objective.1.text: Jonas was a troublemaker. Fought over every bed, every watering can. But I never laid a finger on him. I was at home that evening. Alone, yes. Since when do you need witnesses to sleep?
quest.mord_4.objective.2.text: Jonas was here five days ago. Bought bandages for a gash on the back of his hand. He said he had hurt himself on a garden fence. The fence belonged to his neighbor, I think. Who he meant by that, he did not say.
quest.mord_5.name: What They Are Hiding
quest.mord_5.offer: Kolja keeps behind the containers at the edge of the market what he does not want to show. Hubert has a shed behind his bed. Take a look at both, if you can. I know what I am asking.
quest.mord_5.progress: Behind the containers at the market edge, and in the shed behind Hubert's bed.
quest.mord_5.complete: So he found Jonas and took the bag. That makes him a thief, not a murderer. And Hubert sharpened a wrench. Neither is proof, only reasons. ... Reasons are enough to end a life. I know that now.
quest.mord_5.objective.0.text: Behind the containers, under a tarp, lies a backpack. Rope, flashlight, two empty batteries. The money is missing. In between a note in Kolja's handwriting: “Found him like that. Scared. Taking the bag before someone else does.”
quest.mord_5.objective.1.text: Freshly washed work clothes hang in the shed. On the workbench lies a wrench that was polished bright only recently, dark residue clings in the thread. On the wall stack complaints, all from Jonas, all stamped “Bed No. 14”. That is Hubert's plot.
quest.mord_6.name: The Path in the Forest
quest.mord_6.offer: There was more in the forest than just the site. Someone must have walked that path without anyone seeing. Look around once more, further south along the forest edge. And ask the barber. He looks at everyone's shoes when he shaves their neck.
quest.mord_6.progress: Further south along the western forest edge. And the barber has an eye for shoes.
quest.mord_6.complete: A spade handle with a bed number. A boot with tire rubber. I believe you when you say it was not Kolja. But I also see how much you wish that I would decide. I will. In a moment. Just let me think for one breath.
quest.mord_6.objective.0: Examine the footprints at the forest edge
quest.mord_6.objective.0.text: Prints show in the soft ground. A boot tread, cut from the rubber of a car tire and sewn on, and a narrower pair that ran away from it. Two people, one went back, one did not.
quest.mord_6.objective.1.text: A broken wooden handle sticks out of the leaves. Burned into the top: the number 14. The beds of the garden community are numbered.
quest.mord_6.objective.2.text: Boots with soles of tire rubber? Nobody in Babylos does that except Hubert. He patches everything that way. I cut him new soles the week before last. Why do you ask?
quest.mord_7a.name: The Accusation: Kolja
quest.mord_7a.offer: I have to decide, and I do not want to do it alone. If you say it was Kolja, then go to him and tell him to his face. The bag, the note, the money he owed. Whether that is enough, I will decide afterwards.
quest.mord_7a.progress: Go to Kolja. Tell him what you know.
quest.mord_7a.complete: So it is him. I would have expected it to feel different. Thank you. Here, I set this aside for you. Jonas would have wanted you to have it.
quest.mord_7a.objective.0.text: Kolja goes pale. “I found him. And I took the bag, yes, because I was afraid I would be blamed. That is exactly what is happening now.” He looks at you without blinking. You realize he may be telling the truth, and that it will no longer help him.
quest.mord_7b.name: The Accusation: Hubert
quest.mord_7b.offer: I have to decide, and I do not want to do it alone. If you say it was Hubert, then go to him and tell him to his face. The wrench, the spade handle, the boots. Whether that is enough, I will decide afterwards.
quest.mord_7b.progress: Go to Hubert. Tell him what you know.
quest.mord_7b.complete: He admitted it. Over a bed. I do not know whether to scream or laugh. Thank you for not giving up. Here, I set this aside for you. Jonas would have wanted you to have it.
quest.mord_7b.objective.0.text: Hubert stares at the broken spade handle in your hand. Then he sits down on the ground. “He destroyed my bed. For the third time. I only wanted him to stop.” He shakes his head. “I did not want to kill him.” He says nothing more.
quest.mord_8a.name: Aftermath: Kolja
quest.mord_8a.offer: Kolja is gone. They sent him over the fence yesterday, without luggage. Ask the innkeeper how Babylos is talking about it. I do not dare to go into the tavern.
quest.mord_8a.progress: The innkeeper knows how people talk about Kolja.
quest.mord_8a.complete: The night after the verdict someone tidied up Hubert's bed. No name, not a word. I do not know what that means. Maybe nothing. Take this. It is not enough, but it is all I have.
quest.mord_8a.objective.0: Talk to the Innkeeper about the verdict
quest.mord_8a.objective.0.text: Kolja? They sent him over the fence, at dusk. Nobody drinks loudly here since. Greta sleeps worse, not better, they say. They say someone watered Hubert's bed the night after. Nobody knows who.
quest.mord_8b.name: Aftermath: Hubert
quest.mord_8b.offer: Hubert is sitting in the storeroom behind the market until the community has decided what happens to him. Ask the innkeeper what people are saying. I do not want to hear it myself.
quest.mord_8b.progress: The innkeeper knows how people talk about Hubert.
quest.mord_8b.complete: They took his bed and canceled his water rights. That is the mildest thing they could do to him, and the hardest he can bear. Kolja apologized to me today, for the bag. I shook his hand. Take this. It is not enough.
quest.mord_8b.objective.0: Talk to the Innkeeper about the verdict
quest.mord_8b.objective.0.text: Hubert? Sits in the back storeroom. They want to take his bed and cancel his water rights. Some find it too much, others too little. Since yesterday nobody greets him, and he just sits there looking at his hands.
quest.sewer_passage.name: The Way Underground
quest.sewer_passage.offer: You have proven yourself here. The cover behind me leads into a shaft that runs far beneath Sector 7. I have never been all the way down, and those who came back from below do not like to talk about it. Go through the pump hall, clear the Rat King out of the way and look for the exit at the other end. They say there is a city at the end. I do not know what is true. Take a light, and do not let the water pools surprise you.
quest.sewer_passage.progress: Pump hall, Rat King, exit. The way lies under the cover.
quest.sewer_passage.complete: From the sewers? And all your fingers still on? Sit down before you tip off my chair. A shave is on the house, I reward that much courage. Welcome to Babylos.
quest.sewer_passage.objective.0: Reach the pump hall in the sewers
quest.sewer_passage.objective.2: Reach the exit at the end of the sewers
npc.baron.name: Baron
npc.baron.greeting: What are you staring at? I do not bite. Usually.
npc.annelie.name: Annelie
npc.annelie.greeting: Please, not so loud. Who are you?
quest.baron_1.name: The Man with the Thirst
quest.baron_1.offer: They call me Baron. The Bloody they only say behind my back, and I pretend I do not hear it. My wife Annelie and my daughter Tamara have been gone nine days. Just gone, without a word. I am looking for them, but I am not the man people like to tell things to. They might tell you. Ask the innkeeper and the barber, they see everyone who passes by here.
quest.baron_1.progress: The innkeeper and the barber. They know more than they tell a man like me.
quest.baron_1.complete: So she left at night, with a bundle, and Tamara by the hand. Without a word to me. ... Yes. I know why that is. Let us not talk about it, not yet. Keep looking. I will pay you for it.
quest.baron_1.objective.0.text: Annelie? She was here nine days ago, late, after closing time. Wanted nothing to drink, only water, and asked if I had a room for one night. I said no, because I want no trouble with the Baron. I regret that. She had the girl by the hand and a scarf pulled up to her chin, even though it was warm.
quest.baron_1.objective.1.text: The Baron? Comes every two weeks and does not talk. His wife came once, about the little one's hair. She watched the door the whole time. I have learned not to ask customers who look like that. If you ask me: anyone who looks like that is afraid of whoever walks past the window.
quest.baron_2.name: An Empty Home
quest.baron_2.offer: Take a look at my tent, if you like. I have not touched anything. I cannot bear to be there. The fire pit in front of it, the sewing basket, Tamara's drawing. Maybe you will see what I cannot.
quest.baron_2.progress: The fire pit, the sewing basket, Tamara's drawing. I will stay out here.
quest.baron_2.complete: You have seen it. The fire pit. ... I only swept the stones yesterday, because I thought it would stand out otherwise. It is not what you think. It is ... well. It is exactly that. I am not proud of it.
quest.baron_2.objective.0: Examine the fire pit in front of the Baron's tent
quest.baron_2.objective.0.text: On the paving stones in front of the tent are dark stains, smeared with a rag but not removed. A chair lies overturned, one leg broken off. On the edge of the crate sticks a hair, blond, with a drop of dried blood on it.
quest.baron_2.objective.1.text: The basket stands empty next to the bed roll. Needles, thread and scissors are missing, and so is the winter clothing that usually lies on top. Whoever packs like this meant to stay away a long time.
quest.baron_2.objective.2.text: Charcoal on a piece of cardboard: a tent, two big figures and a small one. One of the big figures stands apart, a good distance from the tent, filled in with heavy, dark strokes. Below, in clumsy writing: “When Papa is angry, we go to the forest.”
quest.baron_3.name: What the Neighbors See
quest.baron_3.offer: She did not simply run into the forest. Someone must have supplied her. Ask the apothecary, the general trader, and Greta. The women talk to each other when the men are not listening.
quest.baron_3.progress: The apothecary, the general trader and Greta. They saw something I did not want to see.
quest.baron_3.complete: Bandages, supplies, a conversation about the road south. She planned it. She really planned it. I always thought she was too ... I do not know what I thought. Follow her trail. But if you find her ... tell me first, before you do anything.
quest.baron_3.objective.0.text: Annelie? She was here ten days ago. Bought bandages and arnica ointment, for herself, she said. One wrist was bruised blue, and on her cheek she had a mark she had covered with powder. I said nothing. I know what I saw. But I also know who it concerns.
quest.baron_3.objective.1.text: She bought bread, cans and two wool blankets. And asked if I knew how far the road south is passable. I said: up to the wrecks, after that no more. She nodded and paid, in small coins. You can tell who has been saving for a long time.
quest.baron_3.objective.2.text: Annelie sometimes sat with me, after Jonas died. She did not say much. Only once: that you can also disappear in a home without anyone noticing. I told her an address in the forest, a place where you can be in peace. I will say no more. If she wants to be found, she can decide that herself.
quest.baron_4.name: The Road South
quest.baron_4.offer: South of the city there is a road that disappears between the wrecks. That is where she was last seen. The area is not safe, deserters roam around. See if you can find a trail, and clear away what blocks your path.
quest.baron_4.progress: The road south. Deserters roam between the wrecks.
quest.baron_4.complete: Cart tracks, small shoes beside them. Both trails lead west, not south. She said she wanted to go south so that someone would run after her and be wrong. Clever. She was always smarter than me.
quest.baron_4.objective.0: Examine the cart track on the south road
quest.baron_4.objective.0.text: In the dust you can make out cart wheels and next to them the prints of small shoes, a child walking a little way beside the track. Then, after thirty steps, both trails turn sharply west, through the grass between the trees. The road south was a decoy.
quest.baron_5.name: The Camp in the Forest
quest.baron_5.offer: West. In the forest, where the trail ends. Look for a spot where someone could hide. If you find her, talk to her. Afterwards tell me what she said. Please.
quest.baron_5.progress: West, in the forest, south of the forest path. Look for a place someone has set up.
quest.baron_5.complete: So she is all right, more or less. And she does not want me to know. ... Then tell me anyway. Where is she? No. Wait. I will not ask you that. Not yet. I first have to decide whether I even want to hear it.
quest.baron_5.objective.0: Search the forest in the southwest
quest.baron_5.objective.1.text: Annelie sits on a tree stump, hands in her lap. She saw you from afar. “He sent you.” It is not a question. “I am not going back. It has nothing to do with courage. It is that I would not have survived it this time, and Tamara would have seen it.” She looks toward the trees. “Tamara has been gone three days. She wanted to fetch water and did not come back. She said she knew a safe place in the northeast, beyond the forest edge. I could not get through, because ... because I must not be where he would look.”
quest.baron_6a.name: The Truth
quest.baron_6a.offer: Tell me where she is. I know what I have done. I promise I will come without a weapon and not one step further than she allows. But I need to see her. And I need to know where my daughter is.
quest.baron_6a.progress: Go to Annelie and tell her the Baron wants to come, alone and unarmed.
quest.baron_6a.complete: She agreed. Ten minutes, no more, ten steps apart. I did not expect that. I stopped expecting anything a long time ago. Thank you. This is for you. I hope I earn something better again one day.
quest.baron_6a.objective.0: Tell Annelie about the Baron's request
quest.baron_6a.objective.0.text: Annelie is silent for a long time. “He wants to come.” She turns her head aside. “Ten steps apart. No hands in pockets. And if he raises his voice even once, I leave, and you will never see me again.” She nods heavily. “Tell him. But I will tell you: I am not doing this for him. I am doing it for Tamara.”
quest.baron_6b.name: The Promise
quest.baron_6b.offer: You found nothing. That is what you say, yes? I notice when someone lies. But I also notice when someone is protecting something. Decide. Go to her and tell her I know nothing and never asked you, or tell me the truth.
quest.baron_6b.progress: Go to Annelie. Tell her you are keeping your word.
quest.baron_6b.complete: So you have decided. Good. I will not ask again. This is for you, for not telling me anything I could not bear. And if Tamara comes back, I will let her go to her mother. That is a promise. Even if I do not deserve it.
quest.baron_6b.objective.0: Tell Annelie you are keeping silent
quest.baron_6b.objective.0.text: Annelie closes her eyes briefly. “Thank you.” She says nothing more, only wipes her face with her sleeve. After a while: “If you find Tamara, bring her to me. No matter what he says.” Then she takes a piece of bread from her bundle and shares it with you, as if it were the only thing she could give you.
quest.baron_7.name: Tamara's Trail
quest.baron_7.offer: Tamara ran northeast three days ago. Beyond the forest edge a narrow path begins between the trees. She said she knew a place where nobody would find her. I do not dare to follow her, because I do not know whom she might meet there. You are strong enough. Please.
quest.baron_7.progress: In the northeast, beyond the forest edge, a narrow path begins. The wild dogs there are dangerous.
quest.baron_7.complete: A scarf. Her red scarf. She never takes it off willingly. ... The trail leads into the forest. In that direction runs a path nobody uses. I never knew where it leads. I pray she did not get far.
quest.baron_7.objective.0: Examine the red scarf at the forest edge
quest.baron_7.objective.0.text: On the edge of a willow bush hangs a red woolen scarf, its fringes frayed. It is damp with dew. Next to it, in the ground, small footprints, hurried, deep at the heel. They run northeast, toward a narrow path that disappears between the trees.
quest.baron_7.objective.1.text: A path barely wider than a person, half overgrown with fern and brambles. It leads between tall spruces into the forest, deeper than the light reaches. On the first tree a scrap of red wool hangs in the undergrowth. Then nothing more. Whoever goes in there goes alone.
quest.baron_8a.name: Aftermath: The Baron and Annelie
quest.baron_8a.offer: I was with her, ten minutes, ten steps. I did not talk, I only listened. Ask the innkeeper how Babylos is talking about it. I do not dare to go into the tavern.
quest.baron_8a.progress: The innkeeper knows how people talk about the Baron.
quest.baron_8a.complete: So they are talking. Good. Talking is better than silence. I have stopped drinking. For the first time in three years I made it through the day sober. I do not know whether it helps. Take this, it is not much.
quest.baron_8a.objective.0: Talk to the Innkeeper about the Baron
quest.baron_8a.objective.0.text: The Baron? Was here three days ago, ordered water. Water! Nobody said anything, but everyone saw it. He paid, left, and did not slam the door. That is more than I have seen from him in three years.
quest.baron_8b.name: Aftermath: Annelie's Promise
quest.baron_8b.offer: I did not ask anything, and you did not say anything. That is a strange feeling, like a deal nobody concluded. Ask the innkeeper how people talk about me. I need to know if word has gone around.
quest.baron_8b.progress: The innkeeper knows how people talk about the Baron.
quest.baron_8b.complete: They say I have become quieter. Maybe that is true. It is like waiting for a verdict that does not come. I will not apologize, I know how cheap that sounds. But if Tamara comes back, I will try to be a man she does not have to fear. Take this.
quest.baron_8b.objective.0: Talk to the Innkeeper about the Baron
quest.baron_8b.objective.0.text: The Baron? Sits in front of his tent in the evening and watches the street. Does not drink anymore, they say. Not a word when he passes someone. Some say he is ill, others that he is afraid of something. I think he is waiting for someone. His wife, or his punishment.
questobject.baron_feuer: Blood Stains in Front of the Tent
